pool_frame_review.note: Recorded by prestage_footage_review.py: every clip named here was sampled across its own duration WHILE STILL ON THE SHELF, and only the accepted ones were then copied. The pool hash is taken after that copy, so the binding is exact at the moment staging completes. 2026-09-05: the pool was then extended by 30 clips (prestage take 2, 117 candidates content-reviewed on the shelf) and the FULL 77-clip pool was re-sampled across each clip's duration (runs/qc/max737_pool_frames.v001.json, 27 sheets all read); three 2026-09-04 accepts carrying a lady-justice/scales prop were rejected on that pass and moved to factory_rejected/, leaving 74. ADDED 2026-09-07: the pool sweep found this episode had NO aviation footage at all, so twenty-five clips were fetched from Pexels and Pixabay and every one was opened at four frames across its duration before anything was staged. Thirteen were refused and are on config/footage_blocklist.v001.json under airline_liveries_and_one_cgi_aeroplane -- a Delta widget tail, the Lufthansa crane on a winglet, RYANAIR titles, FedEx, two United globes, a Go wordmark, an Air Canada rondelle, legible fuselage titles, the registration CC-LBL, a cartoon CGI aeroplane, and one head-on landing with carrier-red nacelles that the haze made unreadable rather than absent. A twelfth accepted clip (AR-pixabay_25593) was staged and then removed: it is byte-identical to frazier/AF-BG-57509. The eleven below are what survived, and the per-clip reasons are the reviewer's own words, not a machine's.

accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pexels_10406880__approach_lights_airl: approach lighting towers with an airliner on short final; the aircraft is a backlit silhouette against overcast and no livery element resolves at full frame
accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pexels_11130977__distant_airliner_in_: overcast cloudscape with a single distant airliner entering frame late; too small for any marking
accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pexels_17812763__jet_engine_fan_blade: fan blades and spinner filling the frame; no wordmark, no nacelle titles, no carrier colour
accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pexels_18248318__distant_takeoff_over: airliner lifting off beyond a grass verge, a dark shape at distance; terminal buildings behind carry no legible sign
accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pexels_31313257__hazy_apron_seen_from: apron seen from a perimeter fence through heavy haze; aircraft are pale smears and nothing resolves
accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pexels_35770564__small_airliner_in_bl: airliner high in blue sky with light cloud; no marking readable
accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pexels_36129056__engine_nacelle_on_we: engine nacelle and fan on a wet apron with the wing behind; no wordmark and no carrier colour on the visible surfaces
accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pexels_37494559__airliner_overhead_bl: airliner passing overhead against clear blue; underside only, no titles
accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pexels_38465315__wing_and_winglet_abo: wing and winglet above a cloud deck from a cabin window; the winglet is unpainted and carries no logo
accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pixabay_52536__engine_spinner_and_fan: engine spinner and fan from the apron; the spiral on the spinner is the universal ground-safety marking, not a brand, and no wordmark appears
accepted_reasons_20260907.AR-pixabay_8725__contrail_across_violet_: a single contrail drawn across a violet dusk sky; no aircraft detail at all
